question: Why is walking the page table on every memory reference a problem?

beats.speaker: interviewer
beats.line: Why is walking the page table on every memory reference a problem?

beats.speaker: student
beats.line: Walking the page table on every memory reference would double memory traffic, so it is not free.
beats.source_quote: Walking the page table on every memory reference would double memory traffic.

beats.speaker: student
beats.line: That doubling is the whole cost, because each reference now needs a second trip to memory.
beats.source_quote: Walking the page table on every memory reference would double memory traffic.

beats.speaker: student
beats.line: So the traffic doubles, which is exactly the problem hardware has to solve here.
beats.source_quote: Walking the page table on every memory reference would double memory traffic.
